_about: Shown once on each phone after it installs a new Android update (not on a first install). Replace the list with what this update changes, in plain words, each time an Android update is approved and built.
items: Scan by photo opens the camera again, to take a photo of the label. Upload photo still lets you choose photos you've already taken.
Stronger, clearer buzzes: one short buzz when a pallet is added and a double buzz for a warning, so you can tell without looking (Settings › Vibrate).
In the camera scanner: change the pallet type, tick FSDU, and Remove last, without closing the camera. The last three pallets show under the picture.
Opening the app with a delivery in progress offers Carry on scanning.
Bigger buttons, for gloves: a switch in Settings › Android app makes Add, Scan, the pallet types and Undo bigger, in the app and in the camera scanner.
The camera scanner has a tall aiming frame for the upright LPN barcodes, flashes green when a pallet is added and orange when it needs a check, and leaves more of the picture clear.
The status and navigation bars follow the app's colours, with dark icons on light colours.
The Saved bar and short messages sit above the Add and Scan bar instead of covering it.
Questions (such as Carry on scanning or the battery reminder) slide up from the bottom; tap outside to close them.
A light tap when you press Add, Scan or a pallet type (with Vibrate on).
The Continue shortcut goes to the LPN box without popping up the keyboard; tap the box when you want to type.
The blank tally sheet no longer mentions the app.
